name: AoE4 Helper - Beastyqt English 2 TC - Abbey into White Tower

steps.action: Put all 6 starting villagers on sheep and rally the Town Center to sheep.
steps.note: Bring sheep home with the scout and keep training villagers. Guide by MicroMindGG, based on Beastyqt's English 2 TC game. https://aoe4guides.com/builds/j4qoTJleWDnW0P0zpFwC

steps.action: Take one villager off sheep to build a house.
steps.note: Send the builder back to sheep afterward. The new villager can start the gold mining camp at the same time.

steps.action: Build a mining camp at gold with the new villager.
Have the mining camp builder mine gold.
Send the next villager to gold for 2 miners.
steps.note: Rally all subsequent villagers to sheep.

steps.action: Keep both gold miners working until you have 200 gold.
steps.note: Keep rallying to sheep.

steps.action: Start the Abbey of Kings with both gold miners.
steps.note: Leave those two villagers to build it alone.

steps.action: Use one villager to start a house around 2:20.
Build a mining camp at stone and a lumber camp at wood.
steps.note: Use 6 villagers from sheep plus new villagers for the two groups. Rally to wood.

steps.action: Put 4 villagers on stone and 4 on wood.
Rally new villagers to wood, bringing the woodcutters to 5.
steps.note: Keep 4 on sheep and 4 on stone until Feudal. Continue rallying to wood.

steps.action: Build a house at 18/20 population.
steps.note: Keep rallying villagers to wood.

steps.action: Bank at least 300 stone for the second Town Center.
steps.note: Keep rallying to wood.

steps.action: When the Abbey finishes and you reach Feudal, send the King to harass.
steps.note: Keep rallying to wood.

steps.action: Move all 4 stone miners and both Abbey builders to wood.
steps.note: The four miners leave stone together.

steps.action: Check that the two Abbey builders are also on wood, bringing the total to 15.
Send 8 woodcutters to the deer pack beside the cliff.
Place the second Town Center on the deer around 5:03.
steps.note: Use all 8 builders.

steps.action: Finish the second Town Center.
steps.note: Rally to food and keep both Town Centers training villagers continuously.

steps.action: Send its 8 builders to hunt the deer under the new Town Center.
steps.note: This brings the food allocation to 16.

steps.action: Send villagers back to gold and stone.
steps.note: Aim for about 13 food, 3 wood, 5 gold and 3 stone. Treat the splits from here on as approximate.

steps.action: Build a barracks.
steps.note: Train spearmen to defend against raids.

steps.action: Bring gold up to around 11 miners for the Castle age-up.
Defend raids at home with spearmen and the King.
steps.note: Keep adding houses. The guide reaches 39/40 population here.

steps.action: Start the White Tower with about 19 villagers to reach Castle quickly.
When the White Tower finishes and you reach Castle, send its builders to wood.
steps.note: Aim for roughly 20 on wood.

steps.action: Research Textiles, Double Broadaxe and Wheelbarrow around 9–12 minutes.
Build farms around the Town Centers.
steps.note: Put men-at-arms in front, with crossbowmen and longbowmen behind.

steps.action: Add blacksmith upgrades.
steps.note: Keep both Town Centers training villagers.
